methods.name: EfficientNetV2 for landslide area detection using RVI
methods.summary: The method uses the Radar Vegetation Index (RVI) derived from Sentinel-1 SAR data as input for the EfficientNetV2 deep learning model to classify bare ground (landslide) versus vegetated areas. The workflow includes speckle noise reduction, geometric correction, RVI calculation, and patch-based classification using the EfficientNetV2 architecture implemented in PyTorch.
methods.verbatim: To classify these areas, the well-known classification method of EfficientNetV2 is used. ... Therefore, we decided to use a method that combines Pytorch and EfficientNetV2.

availability.author_statement: The original contributions presented in this study are included in the article. Further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for training or validation is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the EfficientNetV2 method lacks a repository or persistent link.
